Climeon AB (publ) ("Climeon" or the "Company") carries out a directed share issue of 18,518,519 class B shares at a subscription price of SEK 2.70 per share (the "Share Issue"). The subscription price has been determined through a so-called accelerated bookbuilding procedure performed by Augment Partners AB ("Augment Partners"). The Share Issue is divided into two tranches. The first tranche, comprising 17,979,019 class B shares, has been resolved upon by the Board of Directors pursuant to the authorization granted by the annual general meeting on 18 May 2026 ("Tranche 1"). In Tranche 1, class B shares have been subscribed for by both new investors and existing shareholders, including Tomas Aronsson, J.A Kjellberg och Söner AB, SEB-Stiftelsen, Stefan Wikström and Cidro Förvaltning AB. The second tranche comprises 539 500 class B shares and is proposed to be directed to Board members Thomas Öström and Olle Bergström as well as the Company's CEO Lena Sundquist and CTO Henrik Österman ("Tranche 2"). Tranche 2 requires a separate resolution by an extraordinary general meeting which is expected to be held on or about 29 September 2026. The notice for the extraordinary general meeting will be published through a separate press release.
The Share Issue

The bookbuilding procedure that was announced by the Company earlier today has been completed and Climeon carries out a directed issue of 18,518,519 class B shares at a subscription price of SEK 2.70 per class B share, corresponding to issue proceeds of SEK 50 million before transaction costs.

The Share Issue is divided into two tranches. Tranche 1, comprising 17,979,019 class B shares, has been resolved upon by the Board of Directors pursuant to the authorization granted by the annual general meeting on 18 May 2026. In Tranche 1, class B shares have been subscribed for by both new investors and existing shareholders, including Tomas Aronsson, J.A Kjellberg och Söner AB, SEB-Stiftelsen, Stefan Wikström and Cidro Förvaltning AB. All class B shares in Tranche 1 have been subscribed for and allocated.

The Share Issue pursuant to Tranche 2 comprises 539,500 class B shares and is proposed to be directed to Board members Thomas Öström and Olle Bergström as well as the Company's CEO Lena Sundquist and CTO Henrik Österman. Pursuant to Chapter 16 of the Swedish Companies Act (2005:551) (the so-called ‘Leo rules’), Tranche 2 must be resolved upon by an extraordinary general meeting with the support of at least nine-tenths of both the votes cast and the shares represented at the meeting. Shareholders, holding more than ten percent of the shares and votes in the Company, has therefore submitted a proposal to the extraordinary general meeting regarding the resolution to carry out Tranche 2. The Board of Directors’ resolution regarding Tranche 1 is not contingent upon the extraordinary general meeting resolving to carry out Tranche 2. The extraordinary general meeting is expected to be held on or about 29 September 2026. The notice for the extraordinary general meeting will be published through a separate press release.

The subscription price in the Share Issue has been determined through an accelerated bookbuilding procedure. Consequently, it is the board of directors’ assessment that the subscription price reflects current market conditions and demand and that the subscription price is therefore on market terms. The subscription price corresponds to a discount of 10.0 percent against the closing price on 9 September 2026 and a discount of approximately 10.4 percent against the volume-weighted average price during the last ten trading days.
The use of the issue proceeds

Climeon has, over the past period, established a validated product platform in HeatPower 300 and a growing base of commercial references in both maritime and industrial applications. The Company intends to use the issue proceeds to convert the existing sales pipeline into delivered orders:
i) Continued commercialisation in the maritime segment, building on operational units onboard vessels as a strong commercial reference, including follow-on opportunities.

ii) Commercial scale-up in prioritised industrial segments, focusing on the specific industrial applications and processes where HeatPower 300 has demonstrated near plug-and-play installation and attractive payback.
Deviation from the shareholders' preferential right

In preparation for the Share Issue, the Company's Board of Directors has conducted an analysis of the conditions for, and carefully considered the possibility of raising capital through, a rights issue. The conclusion of this assessment, under the prevailing conditions, is that the Share Issue is the most favorable option for the Company and its shareholders. The reasons for this and the deviation from the shareholders' preferential rights have been based on the following considerations and conclusions:

i) A rights issue would take significantly longer to complete, which may thus risk depriving the Company of the opportunity to raise capital to ensure the Company's liquidity needs in the short and medium term, which could ultimately impair the Company's financial and operational flexibility. The Share Issue also provides the Company with greater flexibility to act on business opportunities and manage prevailing market conditions

ii) Through a directed issue such as the Share Issue, there is potential to diversify and strengthen the Company's shareholder base with both Swedish and international investors and broaden the base of financially strong shareholders who are deemed to have the financial capabilities to support the Company's operations in the long term, which is further deemed to strengthen Climeon's ability to execute on the Company's growth strategy.
iii) The Share Issue is deemed to be able to be carried out at a significantly lower cost and with less complexity than a rights issue.
iv) A rights issue would likely need to be carried out at a significant discount to the market price, which would result in greater dilution for non-participating existing shareholders.

In view of the above, the Board of Directors considers, after an overall assessment, that the Share Issue is the most advantageous option for Climeon to raise capital in a cost and time efficient manner in order to strengthen the Company's financial position, while maintaining the most value in the Company and being most favorable for the Company's shareholders.
Number of shares, share capital and dilution

The Share Issue entails an increase in the Company's share capital by SEK 2,777,777.85 from SEK 9,454,645.20 to SEK 12,232,423.05, and the number of shares increases by 18,518,519 class B shares, from 63,030,968 to 81,549,487 shares (divided into 390,000 class A shares and 81,159,487 class B shares) (calculated on the total number of class B shares in the Share Issue for both Tranche 1 and Tranche 2). The Share Issue entails a dilution of approximately 22.7 percent in relation to the total number of outstanding shares in the Company after the Share Issue.
Lock-up

Shareholding members of the Company's Board of Directors and management have undertaken towards Augment Partners, with certain exceptions, not to dispose of shares or other financial instruments in the Company for a period of 6 months after the announcement of the Share Issue.
Advisors

Augment Partners is Sole Manager and Bookrunner in connection with the Share Issue. BAHR Advokatbyrå is acting as legal advisor to the Company in connection with the Share Issue. Aqurat Fondkommission AB is issuing agent in connection with the Share Issue.
For more information, please contact;
Lena Sundquist, CEO, Climeon

About Climeon AB

Climeon is a Swedish product company operating within the energy technology sector. Climeon's proprietary technology, the Climeon HeatPower system, uses an Organic Rankine Cycle (ORC) process to convert low-temperature heat into clean, carbon free electricity. Providing access to dependable and cost-effective sustainable power, HeatPower enables industries to increase energy efficiency, decrease fuel consumption, and reduce emissions. As a non-weather-dependent source of green energy, HeatPower has the potential to diversify and safeguard the renewable energy mix and, therefore, accelerate the global transition to a net-zero future. Climeon's B shares are listed on the Nasdaq First North Premier Growth Market. FNCA Sweden AB is a Certified Adviser. Learn more at www.climeon.com.

Since Climeon AB (publ) has made the assessment that the Company conducts activities worthy of protection according to the Swedish Foreign Direct Investments Act (Sw. lag (2023:560) om granskning av utländska direktinvesteringar), certain investments in the Share Issue may require review by the Swedish Inspectorate for Strategic Products (Sw. Inspektionen för strategiska produkter). For more information, please visit the Swedish Inspectorate for Strategic Products' website,
www.isp.se
, or contact the Company.
